verdict.headline: No trade today
verdict.reason: USD/CAD broke 1.4125 and retested it, but RSI is overbought and the next resistance gives under 1:2, so it stays on the watchlist. GBP/USD, USD/JPY and EUR/USD have no close beyond a marked level, so there is no break and retest to grade.

watchlist.missing: Long break of 1.4125 on M5: displacement, follow-through, M5 structure break and a wick retest of the level that held (5 of 6 checks, a pin bar at the retest). It fails on two counts. RSI is 76.6, overbought against a long, so the EMA + RSI check fails. The next S/R, the 1.4137 resistance from the M15 chart, is only about 1:1.7 from a roughly 1.4127 entry with the SL at about 1.4121, under the 1:2 minimum. Price is already at 1.4134, so entering now would be chasing.

Price is testing support from above with a small wick below. There is no close below it, no break and no retest yet. A short needs a body close below, M5 structure break and a retest from underneath. On M15 price is 1.3404, rejected at 1.3425 and falling toward the EMA 50 (1.3367), with the EMA 20 still above it and RSI 43. Next support is about 1.3343.
Support held and price bounced to 158.16, with RSI near 70. No break of either level. Resistance at 158.37 would need a close above and a retest.

Price is pressing resistance at 1.11958 and has not closed above it. A long needs a body close above, an M5 structure break and a retest from above with a candle trigger. EMA 20 is above EMA 50 and RSI is 59, so indicators would agree.

Price dipped to 0.5602 support with RSI at its 30 line, then bounced to 0.5607 with no body close below the level. The EMA 20 has crossed below the EMA 50. A short needs a body close below 0.5602, an M5 structure break and a retest from underneath with a candle trigger. RSI must not be below 30 at the retest.
Price was rejected at 0.8227 resistance and has fallen to 0.8206, below the EMAs (RSI 38). No support level is visible on the screenshot, so there is no level to break and retest. Please mark one.

watchFor: USD/CAD: a body close above 1.4137, then a retest from above with a candle trigger, RSI room and at least 1:2 to the next S/R. Otherwise a pullback to 1.4125 that holds with RSI back under 70.
GBP/USD: body close below 1.3407, then a retest from underneath with an engulfing or pin bar.
USD/JPY: body close above 158.37, then a retest from above, with RSI room.
USD/CAD: body close beyond 1.4137 or 1.4054, then a retest.
EUR/USD: body close above 1.1202, then a retest from above with an engulfing or pin bar.
NZD/USD: body close below 0.5602, then a retest from underneath with an engulfing or pin bar and RSI room.
